verdict.rationale: Cognee documents an official Python API (python-api docs, `cognee.remember(...)`, `cognee.start_ui()`), and its own docs describe the CLI as a way to work 'without opening a Python file', confirming Python is the primary programmatic interface. This is a first-party library developers build against directly. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in languages other than Python (e.g. TypeScript), in-depth SDK reference or versioning docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Store data as permanent graph memory or fast session memory in one call.
cognee.remember(data, session_id="my_session") — writes content directly into the session cache for fast retrieval.
It stores information in memory with a single API call.
The cognee-cli command lets you run Cognee from the terminal so you can remember data, enrich memory, and ask questions without opening a Python file.
